title: Canonical restricted unit, local class, module base-change and top-degree adjoint maps
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $P=T\times_S X$, $v:P\to X$ and $f_T:P\to T$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with ordinary tensor pullback and its section-normalized adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. The following are specified canonical maps, not assertions of base-change invertibility. For any morphism $v:Z\to X$ and open $U\subseteq X$, the restricted unit $F|_U\to(v|_{v^{-1}U})_*((v^*F)|_{v^{-1}U})$ is obtained from the ordinary pullback unit by restriction and direct-image composition. For $q\in\mathbf N$, an injective resolution $I$ of $F$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], an open $V\subseteq S$, an open $U\subseteq X$ identified with $f^{-1}V$, and an augmentation-preserving restricted-resolution section identification $R$ [def-pc-restricted-resolution-sections], define $\theta_{f,F,I,V,U,R}^q:H^q(U,F|_U)\to\Gamma(V,R^qf_*F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] by the cocycle-to-sheafification map on the section complex and the resolution comparison with the higher direct image [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write $C=Rf_*(F[0])$ in the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Define $\delta_{f,g,F}:Lg^*C\to Rf_{T,*}((v^*F)[0])$ to be the derived mate followed by the pinned derived-to-ordinary module pullback comparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map] [def-pc-derived-pullback]. If $C$ has cohomology zero above $q$, use the specified isomorphism $\kappa_{g,C}:H^q(Lg^*C)\to g^*H^q(C)$ [lem-weil-pbc-derived-pullback-top-cohomology] and define $a_{f,g,F}^q:R^qf_*F\to g_*R^qf_{T,*}(v^*F)$ as the ordinary adjoint of $H^q(\delta_{f,g,F})\kappa_{g,C}^{-1}$, transported by the canonical total-derived/classical higher-image comparisons. No flatness, affineness, quasi-coherence or invertibility of $\delta$ is required.

lean.statement:
def topBaseChangeAdjoint {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) (q : ℕ)
    (hC : ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F)).IsLE (q : ℤ)) :
    ((pushforward f).rightDerived q).obj F ⟶
      (pushforward g).obj (((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived q).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))

The hC bound is only required for the adjoint, not for the restricted unit, class map or delta.
